notes.title: Happy IGI-versary Agents!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36138616/39770aed497a8e1a8e24b0022a21725bf05e45df.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy IGI-versary Agents![/h1]
We couldn't let today go by without remembering that historic day in 2003, yes, the 20th anniversary of the release of I.G.I.2: Covert Strike.
So to celebrate with us, post your favourite memory of playing I.G.I. 2.

In case you missed it, here are some silhouettes of characters that will feature in I.G.I. Origins, and We look forward to sharing more exciting news about I.G.I. Origins soon!

notes.title: Development Update Information for Unreal Engine on IGI Origins
notes.content:
At AntiMatter Games, we are fully committed to bringing the best game experiences for our players. As part of this initiative, our team has been hard at work and is delighted to share updates on our current projects.

First, we are thrilled to announce that we have moved to Unreal Engine 5! We are confident that the update to the new, superior engine will make a significant impact on our games and ensure we deliver on our promise.

With that goal in mind, we will be shifting gears and focusing our development efforts on ensuring we create the best game experience for IGI: Origins. The game has received overwhelming support from our community thus far, and we can’t wait to share more. In the meantime, we will continue to provide regular development updates via Mission Briefings on our YouTube channel: https://www.youtube.com/c/AntiMatterGamesUK.

Lastly, as we concentrate our efforts on making IGI: Origins everything it can be, we will be pausing development of ’83 for the duration.  We believe that bringing the full team together will allow us to set the quality bar for IGI even higher. 

Our team is extremely excited about the possibilities the latest engine technology can have for our games, and we look forward to sharing more about our development progress in the coming months.

Rich Barham, CEO AntiMatter Games

notes.title: Mission Briefing #3.5 - Bonus AMG Intel
notes.content:
Greetings Agents,

Those of you monitoring our social channels will have seen the Bonus Intel we have been posting over the past couple of weeks, revealing deeper information about the team members who featured in Mission Briefing #3.

In case you missed them, we’ve gathered them all here - so dive in to hear more about what they enjoyed in the original games & their goals for I.G.I. Origins.

[h3][b]Mission Briefing # 3 - Bonus Intel: Luca Uccellatori 
[/b][/h3]
Strategy & choices are some of Lead Game Designer, Luca’s favourite aspects of the original I.G.I. games, ensuring they will also be standout qualities of I.G.I. Origins. His best moment from Project I.G.I. was mentioned by so many of you that it just may be the ultimate fan favourite too! 

[previewyoutube=GiCExVz-c04;full]https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=GiCExVz-c04
[/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Mission Briefing # 3 - Bonus Intel: Mike Ellis
[/b][/h3]
Mike is a Technical Designer on I.G.I. Origins & judging from your comments, you will definitely relate to the satisfaction he gains from playing as a Lone Wolf, outsmarting the A.I. and when needed, mercilessly taking them out. See if you have also used Mike’s favourite tactic from Project I.G.I.

[previewyoutube=q03G7AINQ90;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Mission Briefing # 3 - Bonus Intel: Aymie Thompson
[/b][/h3]
As a Writer for I.G.I. Origins, Aymie’s interest in games with deep, credible narrative & ambiguous characters who may not be as trustworthy as you think, make her the perfect person to craft the game’s twisting story!

[previewyoutube=sS4sh6uRuyM;full][/previewyoutube]


[h3][b]Mission Briefing # 3 - Bonus Intel: Richard Dawson
[/b][/h3]
Richard will bring back great memories with his shout out at the start of this video! As the Lead Cinematics & Video Artist for I.G.I. Origins, his appreciation for the deep atmosphere in the original games will guarantee a dark and unsettling tension permeates I.G.I. Origins.

[previewyoutube=-gC0y7Y3JS0;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3][b]Mission Briefing # 3 - Bonus Intel: Adam Walenkiewicz
[/b][/h3]
[previewyoutube=XI4d6DdllAo;full][/previewyoutube]

Producer, Adam’s summary of the original I.G.I. games’ magic ingredients will resonate with many of you as will the moment he finds the most gratifying! This is someone who knows what’s needed to create a winning game formula!

And I’m Rich Barham, Managing Director at AntiMatter Games and Game Director for I.G.I. Origins. I’m also a great fan of the original I.G.I. games.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36138616/605927f283b9dcc4eded8c680fe38809e13fa44b.jpg[/img]

It was important to me that you met some of the team who are hard at work developing I.G.I. Origins  - and you’ll be seeing a lot more of them as we head towards launch.

We’ve been overwhelmed by your response to our Mission Briefings so far. In our next video we’ll be looking at YOUR favourite moments as told to us by you. So agents, gear up & we’ll see you next time. 

Best,
Rich

P.S. Don’t forget to follow our social channels to catch all of our latest updates .

notes.title: Mission Briefing #2 - Your Feedback
notes.content:
Hi Agents!

Last month in the first of our updates, we mentioned how we had taken a deep dive into the responses from the I.G.I. Fan Survey, to understand what you wanted from a new I.G.I. game. 

The feedback we gained from you was immensely valuable and as it is helping us to shape the game, we wanted to share some of the highlights with you. A huge thank you to everyone who took part! You probably recognise yourself in some of these answers, we certainly saw ourselves! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36138616/c7a829e36a783b40c9087f73343286c8bb4b931f.jpg[/img]

We also wanted to take this opportunity to answer some of the frequently asked questions we have been receiving from you! 

1. What is the release date for the game?
[list]
We know you are eager to know exactly when you can play I.G.I. Origins, and we're eager to get it into your hands! Right now, we can confirm the game is going to be released in 2022, when we are ready to announce the exact release date, you will be the first to know!
[/list]
2. What platforms will I.G.I. Origins release on?
[list]
You can wishlist on STEAM right now, and we’ll have further news regarding other platforms at a later date. 
[/list]
3. What will be the game specs for PC?
[list]
We’ll be able to share detailed specs as we get closer to launch. 
[/list]
4. Will there be a Multiplayer game mode?
[list]
I.G.I Origins is a single player experience.   
[/list]
5. Will there be a remaster of the original games?
[list]
The publishing rights for Project I.G.I. & I.G.I.-2: Covert Strike are retained by their original publishers so we are unable to remaster these games.
[/list]
6. Will there be any returning characters?
[list]
We’ll have more video updates for you over the coming months to give you a deeper insight into the characters being developed for I.G.I. Origins. Stay tuned! 
[/list]
7. Will AntiMatter Games be working with Kim Jensen for this game?
[list]
Good question! We are also big fans of Kim Jensen & his work! The audio is incredibly important for building tension in the game, and we can’t wait to share our plans for this.  
[/list]
8. What game engine is being used?
[list]
I.G.I. Origins is being developed using Unreal Engine 4.
[/list]
9. Will a beta version of the game be released?
[list]
We’ll be sharing more specific info about the game as we get closer to launch.  
[/list]
10. Will there be Easter Eggs in the game?
[list]
Couldn’t possibly answer this! It’s meant to be a surprise! Although it might be worth checking out our Update videos to see if there is anything there...
[/list]

If you have any other questions or feedback please let us know here or on I.G.I. Origin's official [url=https://www.facebook.com/igioriginsofficial/]Facebook[/url], [url=https://twitter.com/IGI_Origins]Twitter [/url]or [url=https://discord.com/invite/igiorigins]Discord channel[/url], we will do our best to answer as much as we can. Sometimes it’s not possible to confirm the exact information you want, but this way we learn what is important to you & know what details to share as soon as we can! Don’t forget to follow us on Steam and on our I.G.I social channels to catch all our latest updates.

See you next month ☺

The AMG Team.

notes.title: Mission Briefing #1 - The Spirit of I.G.I.
notes.content:
Hello everybody!

It’s the AntiMatter Games team here. We know it’s been a while since we gave you an
update on I.G.I Origins. We want to be better at this, so going forward we are excited to
start sharing more news and information about the game and the progress we are making.
We posted our first update today, a video from our studio Managing Director and Game
Director for I.G.I. Origins, Rich Barham, you can watch it here:

[previewyoutube=2qj8EGWRP60;full][/previewyoutube]


The most frequently asked question we receive from you is about the release date. We are
working hard on the game, development is going really well and it’s going to be released in
2022. We’re not ready to share an exact release date just yet, but rest assured we’ll share
more as soon as we can, so be sure to follow our I.G.I channels for updates.

Another question that we are asked is whether there is anyone from the original
development team, Innerloop Studios, working on I.G.I. Origins? Many of the team at
Antimatter Games are BIG fans of the original games, much like yourselves and whilst we
don’t have anyone from Innerloop Studios working here, we are really passionate about
keeping the spirit of the original games alive. Rich talks about this in his video and we are
going to introduce you to more members of the team at the studio very soon!

Please keep your questions and feedback coming, we appreciate your support and will do
our best to answer as much as we can. Don’t forget to follow us on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1186430/IGI_Origins/]Steam  [/url] or
via I.G.I. Origin's official [url=https://www.facebook.com/igioriginsofficial/]Facebook [/url]or [url=https://twitter.com/IGI_Origins]Twitter[/url] to catch all our latest updates.

Bye for now!

The AMG team.
